name: Liz Wangerin
description: Third Wangerin sibling. Central figure of the 2015 friend group complications — JD, Merrick, Aaron Daniels, and Colby Criscitello all had feelings for her in the same year, a fact JD describes as juvenile but real. Lived in the Meyers garage guest room for fall 2015 with Morgan Morse and Laura Siddon.
bio: Part of the Moira-era friend group. Four years older than JD. He had feelings for her around age 14 at the same time Merrick Sinclair pursued a secret relationship with her. Observing Merrick's approach — secretive, eventually discovered — generated a procedural lesson in JD rather than a moral one. He later credited this as one of the links in the chain that led to his approach with Bronwyn. Her sister Lydia Wangerin is a separate figure in the record.
